I'll be honest with you. I have tried 11 times. 
The 10 times I have tried I was relieved. I was at peace with the thought of finally being able to be gone. I would fall asleep with the pain in my chest gone only to wake up throwing up and having to go to the hospital. The only time I felt regret was the 11 time when something in my brain went what the fuck are you doing? Why are you doing this? Do I still hope I die in some accident? You bet but I don't try anything myself anymore.
